description: An id no live session carries answers `no such terminal` — the id is named, nothing was touched. A CLOSED session is gone, not parked; the listing is the way back to a live id.

data.means: nothing was read, typed into, resized or killed — the id names a session that was never opened or has already been closed (a closed session is gone, not parked)
